branches_area_parent_check.name: branches_area_parent_check
branches_area_parent_check.value:
("branches"."area_id" is null or "branches"."city_id" is not null)
      and ("branches"."sub_area_id" is null or "branches"."area_id" is not null)

branches_submission_fields_check.name: branches_submission_fields_check
branches_submission_fields_check.value:
"branches"."verification_status" in ('draft', 'changes_requested', 'rejected') or (
        "branches"."category" is not null and "branches"."city_id" is not null
        and "branches"."area_id" is not null and "branches"."address_line" is not null
        and length(btrim("branches"."address_line")) > 0 and "branches"."location" is not null)

files_clean_digest_check.name: files_clean_digest_check
files_clean_digest_check.value: "files"."scan_status" <> 'clean' or octet_length("files"."sha256") = 32 and "files"."sha256" is not null

room_types_prices_check.name: room_types_prices_check
room_types_prices_check.value:
"room_types"."deposit_paisa" >= 0
    and ("room_types"."bed_monthly_rent_paisa" is null or "room_types"."bed_monthly_rent_paisa" >= 0)
    and ("room_types"."room_monthly_rent_paisa" is null or "room_types"."room_monthly_rent_paisa" >= 0)
    and ("room_types"."inventory_mode" = 'whole_room' or "room_types"."bed_monthly_rent_paisa" is not null)
    and ("room_types"."inventory_mode" = 'per_bed' or "room_types"."room_monthly_rent_paisa" is not null)

booking_policies_platform_current_uq.name: booking_policies_platform_current_uq
booking_policies_platform_current_uq.where: "booking_policies"."is_current" and "booking_policies"."brand_id" is null and "booking_policies"."branch_id" is null

booking_policies_branch_current_uq.name: booking_policies_branch_current_uq
booking_policies_branch_current_uq.where: "booking_policies"."is_current" and "booking_policies"."branch_id" is not null and "booking_policies"."room_type_id" is null

booking_policies_scope_check.name: booking_policies_scope_check
booking_policies_scope_check.value:
("booking_policies"."brand_id" is null or ("booking_policies"."branch_id" is null and "booking_policies"."room_type_id" is null))
    and ("booking_policies"."room_type_id" is null or "booking_policies"."branch_id" is not null)

booking_policies_limits_check.name: booking_policies_limits_check
booking_policies_limits_check.value:
("booking_policies"."brand_id" is null and "booking_policies"."branch_id" is null and "booking_policies"."platform_limits" is not null)
    or (("booking_policies"."brand_id" is not null or "booking_policies"."branch_id" is not null) and "booking_policies"."platform_limits" is null)

listing_media_public_order_idx.name: listing_media_public_order_idx
listing_media_public_order_idx.where: "listing_media"."archived_at" is null and "listing_media"."published_at" is not null

bookings_request_expiry_check.name: bookings_request_expiry_check
bookings_request_expiry_check.value:
("bookings"."state" <> 'pending_request' or "bookings"."request_expires_at" is not null)
    and ("bookings"."request_expires_at" is null or "bookings"."request_expires_at" > "bookings"."created_at")

generated.as:
CASE WHEN seat_ordinal IS NULL THEN int4range(NULL, NULL, '[)')
    ELSE int4range(seat_ordinal, seat_ordinal + 1, '[)') END

inventory_claims_range_check.name: inventory_claims_range_check
inventory_claims_range_check.value: CASE WHEN "inventory_claims"."move_out_date" is null THEN "inventory_claims"."assignment_id" is not null ELSE "inventory_claims"."move_in_date" < "inventory_claims"."move_out_date" END

inventory_claims_expiry_check.name: inventory_claims_expiry_check
inventory_claims_expiry_check.value: "inventory_claims"."hold_id" is null or "inventory_claims"."expires_at" is not null

booking_documents_review_check.name: booking_documents_review_check
booking_documents_review_check.value:
("booking_documents"."state" = 'pending' and "booking_documents"."reviewed_at" is null and "booking_documents"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null)
    or ("booking_documents"."state" <> 'pending' and "booking_documents"."reviewed_at" is not null and "booking_documents"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null)

booking_documents_consumption_check.name: booking_documents_consumption_check
booking_documents_consumption_check.value: "booking_documents"."consumed_at" is null or ("booking_documents"."booking_id" is null and "booking_documents"."state" <> 'rejected')

residents_email_check.name: residents_email_check
residents_email_check.value: "residents"."email" is null or length("residents"."email") between 3 and 254

stays_source_check.name: stays_source_check
stays_source_check.value: ("stays"."source" = 'booking' and "stays"."booking_id" is not null and "stays"."user_id" is not null) or ("stays"."source" = 'manual' and "stays"."booking_id" is null)

stays_closed_check.name: stays_closed_check
stays_closed_check.value: ("stays"."state" in ('completed','terminated','abandoned') and "stays"."closed_at" is not null and "stays"."closed_at" >= "stays"."checked_in_at") or ("stays"."state" not in ('completed','terminated','abandoned') and "stays"."closed_at" is null)

billing_policies_platform_current_uq.name: billing_policies_platform_current_uq
billing_policies_platform_current_uq.where: "billing_policies"."is_current" and "billing_policies"."brand_id" is null and "billing_policies"."branch_id" is null

billing_policies_branch_current_uq.name: billing_policies_branch_current_uq
billing_policies_branch_current_uq.where: "billing_policies"."is_current" and "billing_policies"."branch_id" is not null and "billing_policies"."room_type_id" is null

billing_policies_scope_check.name: billing_policies_scope_check
billing_policies_scope_check.value: ("billing_policies"."brand_id" is null or ("billing_policies"."branch_id" is null and "billing_policies"."room_type_id" is null)) and ("billing_policies"."room_type_id" is null or "billing_policies"."branch_id" is not null)

resident_charges_period_check.name: resident_charges_period_check
resident_charges_period_check.value: ("resident_charges"."period_start" is null and "resident_charges"."period_end" is null) or ("resident_charges"."period_start" is not null and "resident_charges"."period_end" is not null and "resident_charges"."period_start" < "resident_charges"."period_end")

resident_invoices_void_check.name: resident_invoices_void_check
resident_invoices_void_check.value: ("resident_invoices"."state" = 'issued' and num_nonnulls("resident_invoices"."voided_at","resident_invoices"."voided_by_user_id","resident_invoices"."void_reason") = 0) or ("resident_invoices"."state" = 'voided' and num_nonnulls("resident_invoices"."voided_at","resident_invoices"."voided_by_user_id","resident_invoices"."void_reason") = 3 and length(btrim("resident_invoices"."void_reason")) between 1 and 500 and "resident_invoices"."voided_at" >= "resident_invoices"."issued_at")

resident_ledger_funding_check.name: resident_ledger_funding_check
resident_ledger_funding_check.value: (("resident_ledger"."payment_id" is not null or "resident_ledger"."fund_movement_id" is not null or "resident_ledger"."payment_reversal_id" is not null) = ("resident_ledger"."funding_payment_id" is not null)) and ("resident_ledger"."payment_id" is null or "resident_ledger"."payment_id" = "resident_ledger"."funding_payment_id")

resident_ledger_reversal_check.name: resident_ledger_reversal_check
resident_ledger_reversal_check.value: ("resident_ledger"."payment_reversal_id" is not null) = ("resident_ledger"."reversed_entry_id" is not null) and ("resident_ledger"."reversed_entry_id" is null or "resident_ledger"."reversed_entry_id" <> "resident_ledger"."id")
